faq.q: What is the cheapest boat rental for a hen party in Marbella?
faq.a: The most affordable option is the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, starting at €749 for 2 hours (up to 11 guests). For a full day, €2,299 covers 8 hours with unlimited drinks and snacks.

faq.q: How many people can join a hen party boat in Marbella?
faq.a: Our fleet accommodates groups from 5 to 12 guests. The Dubhe (5 pax) is ideal for an intimate group, while the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94 can host up to 12 guests for a larger celebration.

faq.q: What is included in the hen party boat rental price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. VAT (21%) is always included.

faq.q: Are there extra costs I should budget for?
faq.a: Yes: transfers to Puerto Banús, a photographer, decorations, a DJ or playlist, and gratuities for the crew. Some boats allow catering upgrades at an additional cost.

faq.q: Can we bring our own decorations or food?
faq.a: Most boats allow hen party decorations (balloons, banners) as long as they don't damage the vessel. Outside food is generally not permitted, but we offer catering packages on request.

faq.q: What is the best time of day for a hen party boat rental?
faq.a: Late afternoon (4pm to sunset) is popular for golden hour photos and a relaxed vibe. Morning charters (10am–12pm) are quieter and often cheaper.

faq.q: How do I book a hen party boat in Marbella for 2027?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote. We recommend booking 2–3 months in advance for summer weekends to secure your preferred boat and time slot.

faq.q: Can we add a jet ski to our hen party charter?
faq.a: Yes! The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) includes a free jet ski for 4-hour charters. For other boats, jet skis can be added for an extra fee – ask us for details.

data.body_html:
Planning a hen party in Marbella? A boat rental is the ultimate way to celebrate – sun, sea, and champagne on the Costa del Sol. This budget breakdown for 2027 covers everything from €749 2-hour trips to €4,719 luxury charters, so you can choose the perfect option without surprises. All prices include skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT – no hidden fees.

Why Choose a Boat Rental for Your Hen Party?

Marbella's coastline is made for parties: anchor at Cala del Faro, swim off Cabopino, or cruise past the Golden Mile. With a private boat, you control the music, the drinks, and the itinerary. Plus, you skip the crowded beach clubs.

2027 Pricing Tiers: Tier A – Budget-Friendly Hen Parties

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours and go up to €2,299 for 8 hours. These yachts are 12.5m long and hold 9–11 guests. Ideal for small groups wanting a stylish yet affordable day out. Includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance.

2027 Pricing Tiers: Tier B – Luxury with Jet Ski

Tier B features the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 guests) at €4,719 minimum 4 hours. This includes a free jet ski – a huge hit for hen parties. Perfect for groups who want space, speed, and a wow factor. All other boats (e.g., Ferretti 94, Azimut 58) are priced on request via WhatsApp.

What's Included in Every Charter?

  • Licensed skipper (English-speaking)
  • Fuel for the duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, fruit)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • 21% Spanish IVA (VAT)

Budgeting Extra Costs for Your Hen Party

Beyond the base rental, consider: transfers to Puerto Banús (€30–€50 per person by taxi/minibus), a photographer (€200–€400), decorations (€50–€150), and a tip for the crew (10–15% of the charter fee). Some boats allow catering upgrades – ask us for options.

Pro Tips for a Perfect Hen Party Boat Day

Book 2–3 months in advance for summer weekends. Choose a late afternoon slot (4pm–sunset) for golden hour photos. Bring a playlist, sunscreen, and towels. Most boats allow decorations – just confirm with us first. For a luxury upgrade, consider the Mangusta 80 with its free jet ski.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the cheapest boat rental for a hen party in Marbella?

The most affordable option is the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, starting at €749 for 2 hours (up to 11 guests). For a full day, €2,299 covers 8 hours with unlimited drinks and snacks.

How many people can join a hen party boat in Marbella?

Our fleet accommodates groups from 5 to 12 guests. The Dubhe (5 pax) is ideal for an intimate group, while the Mangusta 80 or Ferretti 94 can host up to 12 guests for a larger celebration.

What is included in the hen party boat rental price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, safety equipment, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. VAT (21%) is always included.

Are there extra costs I should budget for?

Yes: transfers to Puerto Banús, a photographer, decorations, a DJ or playlist, and gratuities for the crew. Some boats allow catering upgrades at an additional cost.

Can we bring our own decorations or food?

Most boats allow hen party decorations (balloons, banners) as long as they don't damage the vessel. Outside food is generally not permitted, but we offer catering packages on request.

What is the best time of day for a hen party boat rental?

Late afternoon (4pm to sunset) is popular for golden hour photos and a relaxed vibe. Morning charters (10am–12pm) are quieter and often cheaper.

How do I book a hen party boat in Marbella for 2027?

Contact us via WhatsApp for a personalised quote. We recommend booking 2–3 months in advance for summer weekends to secure your preferred boat and time slot.

Can we add a jet ski to our hen party charter?

Yes! The Mangusta 80 (Tier B) includes a free jet ski for 4-hour charters. For other boats, jet skis can be added for an extra fee – ask us for details.
